data_deps.name: image_captioning_flickr8k
data_deps.description: Pinned official Flickr8k protocol: all 6000 training images and five captions per image (30000 image-caption pairs), plus all 1000 official test images and five references per image. Frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 embeddings and a pinned frozen GPT-2 small snapshot are hash-verified before ten complete mapping-training epochs and full CIDEr/BLEU-4 evaluation.
